plainTranslation: Their Saturn in your 2nd house: they bring seriousness to your resources and worth; stability and discipline, or restriction around money. Failure mode: feeling financially controlled or judged. Build security together; don't let one ration the other's worth.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry house overlay material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
